Name: (CP) Maximalism - Kitchenalia
Author: smallcopper
Description:
Maximalism's Kitchenalia, re-published in one place. Has its own shiny mod now. (yay)

If you're new here, hi! I'm the president of the anti-minimalism brigade and i need stuff to annihilate every single surface available. If you're a veteran Maximalist, this mod includes everything the 'Kitchenalia' collection did, but updated and separated from the other collections I'll be posting. Check out my mod page & download [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/35731]my catalogue[/url] to keep everything together :)
(An AT version combining everything is on the way. sit tight)

Install with Content Patcher. The items should appear in whatever design/cheat/library mod you happen to be using (or my catalogue!)

I hiiighly recommend using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19675]Happy Home Designer[/url]﻿ and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23488]Precise Furniture[/url] for decorating...literally lifesavers if you're me and have a billion AT/CP furniture mods installed. I don't have a simple list of stuff used in my screenshots, but if anyone has any 'where did you get [x]?' type questions, drop me a comment and i'll try and point you in the right direction!

As always, let me know if you come across any issues/bugs/stray pixels. thanks for being here:)
